about: Registry of the official sources the site depends on. One item per figure on the site (indicator, canton field, quiz fact). 'shown' says where the watcher reads the period the site shows and the link visitors see; 'probes' say how to notice a newer edition; 'manual' marks what a person checks by hand. Built on 2026-11-26 from the data files on dev and the fact-check of that day (swissdata-verifica-2026-11-26). How to add a source: see README, section 'Source watcher'.

probe_kinds.fso-dam: FSO DAM API, https://dam-api.bfs.admin.ch/hub/api/dam/assets?orderNr=<orderNr>. Fingerprint: asset id, publication date, provisional flag of the current asset. Period: description.bibliography.period.
probe_kinds.fso-pxweb: FSO STAT-TAB (PXWeb) API. Fingerprint: the table's 'updated' timestamp and the last value of its time variable. Period: that last value.
probe_kinds.eurostat: Eurostat dissemination API (JSON-stat), filtered to Switzerland. Fingerprint: latest period with a value and a hash of the values. Period: latest period with a value.
probe_kinds.snb-cube: SNB data portal API: /api/cube/<id>/lastUpdate and the latest date in the data.
probe_kinds.http-headers: A file at a stable address: ETag / Last-Modified from a HEAD request.
probe_kinds.http-hash: A small file or API answer at a stable address: SHA-256 of the content (for servers without reliable headers).
probe_kinds.http-regex: A page that lists the editions: the set of matches of a pattern (e.g. file names with a year). Optional period: the highest year in the matches.
probe_kinds.calendar-year: No request. The figure is defined per calendar year (premium of the year, budget of the year, state on 1 January): flags when the site shows an earlier year than today's.
probe_kinds.options: compare_period: false = do not compare periods for this probe (why says why); period_offset: -1 = the site is expected to show the year before the newest one (e.g. the newest is only an estimate); edition: 'annual' = for a monthly or quarterly FSO table, only a new complete year counts as a new publication.
probe_kinds.shown: Where the period shown on the site is read: from indicators (src/data/indicators.ts, latest year in the chart), questions (src/data/questions.ts, year in the question), cantons (src/data/cantons.ts, year shown on the canton page), context (src/data/indicators.ts, latest year in the English info text of the card: context and the year of related; the same texts in it/de/fr are in src/i18n/dataTranslations.ts). A list checks several places.
